mode: read-only repository; test artifacts only under /tmp
inspection_detail: Deep path inspection: checkpoint epoch/compaction; writer entry/fencing and keyless SQL; spool encode/quota/lifecycle; promote resume/cutover. Selective sections only for wider pipeline, verify, seed, objects helpers. Not exhaustive review of all listed packages.
invariants: SG-1 stale instance cannot create a worker row that grants itself write authority after takeover
CP-1 target data and applied checkpoint commit together
CP-5 strict orderer waits before target row locks and fails on uncertain commit
CO-1 scheduler retains dependencies and uses table fallback for spilled writesets
spool usage must include durable sidecar data and hard limits must bound prefetch disk use
keyless UPDATE/DELETE must affect exactly one physical row, including partitioned targets
promote resume must revalidate catchup after a connection-scoped fence was lost
source position metadata parsing and seed invariants fail closed
verify stable source recheck must compare canonical same-column data
findings: stale relaxed worker inserted after takeover bypasses epoch fence
PG keyless SQL uses ctid without tableoid across partitioned/inherited relations
spool hard limits exclude spilled transaction sidecar bytes
conditional_findings: FTWRL re-fence resume skips already-completed catchup and setval; requires writes while prior process absent, which is a documented FTWRL operational caveat
retracted_candidates: spool does not serialize PG XID, but current production prefetch replay is source-MySQL-only, so no reachable PG bug shown
gaps: No Docker, DB, E2E, full suite, or races run because benchmark active
Stale-worker reproducer uses deterministic fake SQL state and real EnsureWorkerRow/Compact/ApplyBatch; no live takeover process test
Keyless partition defect confirmed by generated SQL and physical tuple identity reasoning; SQL reproduction supplied but not executed
No deep inspection of seed physical WAL planners, seed dump parsing, objects SQL conversion/parser/discovery, spool bucket HTTP implementation
PGStore and applied_set/range_set/binlog_pos algebra not deeply inspected
No exhaustive writer SQL type or cascading-constraint validation; coverage focused on boundary guarantees
